newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SPHINX HALTS KERAMIK MERGER TALKS.
newsitem.headline: SPHINX HALTS KERAMIK MERGER TALKS.

text.p: Koninklijke Sphinx NV said on Monday it had halted merger talks with Swiss Keramik Holding AG Laufen.
"N.V. Koninklijke Sphinx Gustavsberg (Sphinx) and Keramik Holding AG Laufen (Laufen) announce that they halted talks aimed at merging their sanitaryware activities," Sphinx said in a statement.
It said the talks had foundered on a failure to reach agreement about the inclusion of third-party interests in the joint venture.

"The point of departure for the talks has always been that both parties would group all their sanitaryware activities in the new Joint Venture, in which Sphinx and Laufen would each hold 50 percent of the voting shares," Sphinx said.

"To this end third party interests were also to have been grouped under the joint venture within the foreseeable future. Negotiations on this point did not achieve the desired result," the company said.

Sphinx and Keramik Laufen said in June they planned to merge their sanitaryware divisions into a 50-50 joint venture to create Europe's biggest player in this sector with annual turnover of some 1.4 billion guilders.
The joint venture was to have include Keramik Laufen's interests in Germany's Duravit and Portugal's Sanitana, the two companies said in June.
The Swiss group was to have raised its stake in these units to respectively 100 percent and an unspecified majority holding before bringing them into the joint venture.
Sphinx said on Monday it would continue to implement a reorganisation programme aimed at a structural improvement in profitability.
It said it planned to look into cutting costs by relocating production in other geographical areas, and to review the positioning of its tiling activities within its product portfolio.
